title: Introspective Uncertainty Estimation for LLM-Based Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.13975v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation but can produce fluent yet functionally incorrect outputs, which limits trust in their usage for practical software engineering workflows. This thesis investigates whether Introspective Uncertainty Estimation (IUE), based on internal hidden-state representations of LLMs, can reliably indicate correctness at the response and line levels for code generation tasks. The objective is to determine the extent to which hidden states encode information about functional code correctness and how this can be leveraged for practical risk assessment and fault localization. Methodologically, this thesis combines response-level evaluation on LiveCodeBench (LCB) and BigCodeBench (BCB) with an augmentation pipeline that derives token- and line-level labels from incorrect programs. translated_title: 面向大语言模型代码生成的内省式不确定性估计
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于代码生成，但它们可能产生看起来流畅却在功能上不正确的输出，这限制了人们在实际软件工程工作流程中使用这些模型的信任度。本论文研究基于大语言模型内部隐状态表示的内省式不确定性估计（IUE）能否在响应级别和代码行级别上可靠地指示代码生成任务的正确性。研究目标是确定隐状态在多大程度上编码了关于代码功能正确性的信息，以及如何利用这一点进行实际的风险评估和故障定位。在方法论上，本论文将在LiveCodeBench（LCB）和BigCodeBench（BCB）上的响应级别评估与一条从错误程序中派生token级别和行级别标签的增强流水线相结合。在此设置下，论文比较了静态和动态的响应级别特征，并评估了跨（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本论文提出基于大语言模型内部隐状态的内省式不确定性估计方法，能够在响应和代码行级别可靠预测生成代码的功能正确性，从而支持实际的风险评估与故障定位。
en_tdlr: This thesis shows that introspective uncertainty estimation based on LLMs' internal hidden states can reliably predict the functional correctness of generated code at both response and line levels, enabling practical risk assessment and fault localization.
